title: Updating the current vertex
statement: For any register state and any natural number $z$, replacing its current-vertex field by $z$ gives a register-value vector equal to the vector obtained by replacing coordinate $4$ of the original vector by $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $4$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $4$th coordinate to $z$.
